# archestra_model (Data Source)

Finds an LLM model the platform discovered from a provider key, by its provider-facing name. Use `id` wherever a model's database UUID is expected, such as `model_id` on `archestra_agent`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a model the platform discovered from a provider key, by the name the
# provider knows it by. `llm_provider` is only needed when several providers
# expose the same name.
data "archestra_model" "claude_sonnet" {
  model_id     = "claude-sonnet-4-5"
  llm_provider = "anthropic"
}

# Pin an agent to that model and to a key that exists already, without pasting
# either ID. `model_id` on the agent is the model's database UUID.
resource "archestra_agent" "release_notes" {
  name           = "Release notes"
  system_prompt  = "Write release notes from the merged pull requests."
  model_id       = data.archestra_model.claude_sonnet.id
  llm_api_key_id = data.archestra_model_provider.anthropic.id
}

data "archestra_model_provider" "anthropic" {
  llm_provider = "anthropic"
  is_primary   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_id` (String) Provider-facing model name, such as `claude-sonnet-4-5`.

### Optional

- `llm_provider` (String) Provider that serves the model, such as `anthropic`. Required when several providers expose the same `model_id`.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_ids` (List of String) IDs of the provider keys the model is reachable through, in the order the API lists them.
- `context_length` (Number) Context window in tokens, when known.
- `description` (String) Description of the model, when the provider gives one.
- `id` (String) Database UUID of the model.
